dish: verse, eerlijke brasseriegerechten met een fenomenale wijnkaart
w: A stylish, long-established brasserie in the artists' village — simple but refined cooking from the freshest produce (olive oil, organic meat, shellfish) and a phenomenal cellar. In the Michelin Guide.
A lively Sint-Martens-Latem brasserie whose cooking has gained focus and refinement — a second Gault&Millau toque and a place in the Michelin Guide.
A Michelin-listed Sint-Martens-Latem restaurant serving traditional, generous cooking in a converted barn — a Leie-region classic.

dish: gastronomie aan de Leie; zomerterras aan het water
w: A refined riverside hotel-restaurant in Deurle right on the Leie, with a coveted summer terrace over the water — the region's classic address for a long lunch by the river.

dish: comfortabel tafelen bij de Oude Leie — Gault&Millau
w: A comfortable Gault&Millau restaurant in a quiet green setting between the village square of Bachte and the banks of the Oude Leie, near Ooidonk Castle.
A well-regarded Gault&Millau restaurant in Deinze serving polished seasonal cooking, on the avenue named for painter Emile Claus.

dish: seizoensgerechten met terras aan de Leie — Gault&Millau
w: A Gault&Millau restaurant on the banks of the Leie in Deinze, with a terrace over the water and a market-driven seasonal menu.
A Gault&Millau bistro in central Deinze offering honest, well-executed dishes in a relaxed setting.
An intimate, cosy café-restaurant near Ooidonk in Bachte-Maria-Leerne, listed by Gault&Millau — a relaxed stop on a Leie-valley outing.
